card.name: Cerebral and linking words in stimulant warnings
card.fires_on: The word "cerebral" in lists of adverse events like seizures and cerebral vascular accidents. Also small linking words ("in", "and") in stimulant abuse and dependence warnings.

modes.label: Cerebral in adverse-event lists
modes.description: The word cerebral opens a brain-related event after a list of symptoms.
modes.example: Serotonin syndrome, seizures,<< cerebral>> vascular accidents, and coma may occur.

modes.label: Linking word in abuse warnings
modes.description: "in" or "and" inside stimulant misuse and dependence phrases.
modes.example: Misuse and abuse of CNS stimulants, including AZSTARYS, can result<< in>> overdose and death [see Overdosage
